# Butterfly Built

> Butterfly Built is a premium carpentry company based in Dover Heights, Sydney, Australia.
> We deliver bespoke joinery, decking, kitchens, wardrobes, staircases, heritage restoration
> and renovation carpentry across Sydney, with a focus on the Eastern Suburbs.

## Quick facts
- Business name: Butterfly Built
- Location / workshop: Dover Heights, Sydney NSW 2030, Australia
- Service area: All of Sydney, with focus on Bondi and the Eastern Suburbs
- Founder: Jon
- Phone: 0457 324 417 (international: +61 457 324 417)
- Email: jon@butterflybuilt.com.au
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/butterfly.built (@butterfly.built)
- Website: https://butterflybuilt.com.au
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–5pm, Sat 8am–2pm
